feeds.title: Menstrual Matters Blog
feeds.description: Menstrual Matters is a non-profit online hub that hopes to raise awareness of the role of the menstrual cycle, and hormonal medications, in causing, or affecting, the symptoms of chronic health issues. Take control of your health by understanding how it relates to your menstrual cycle or hormonal medication. Improving the diagnosis and treatment of women's chronic health issues.

feeds.title: Mooncup Blog
feeds.description: Articles about menstrual cups, menstruation, our business, and many more related topics. Mooncup is the original, soft, medical-grade silicone menstrual cup designed by women as a convenient, safe, and eco-friendly alternative to tampons and pads.

feeds.title: Binti Blog
feeds.description: Every girl deserves dignity. Binti International is the UK registered charity and Indian Trust committed to creating affordable sanitary towels. Through education, we are raising the awareness of the menstrual cycle. We hire local women to produce and sell low-cost sanitary pads making them available for everyone. Our educational programmes are designed to eliminate the myths and taboos associated with the period.

feeds.title: TOTM
feeds.description: Our Period Powerful Hub contains all you need to take power over your menstrual wellness. Includes tips, news, inspirational profiles, and #switchstories

feeds.title: Irise international Blog
feeds.description: Irise is an organisation which works towards empowering and educating girls and young women in East Africa so that they will have a voice that cannot be ignored and the ability to work towards solutions to the problems they face. Empowering girls and supporting communities to break the menstrual taboo, enabling girls to menstruate in dignity and realise their full potential.

feeds.title: Eco dreams Blog
feeds.description: Eco Dreams is an ethical retailer specialising in Menstrual cups and Cloth menstrual pads: a modern, healthy and convenient alternative to disposable menstrual products. Ditch the chemicals, waste and make the switch.
